🎬 American Sniper (2014)

American Sniper tells the story of Chris Kyle, a U.S. Navy SEAL sniper whose extraordinary skills make him one of the most effective marksmen in American military history. During multiple deployments to Iraq, Kyle faces dangerous combat missions, intense battlefield decisions, and the constant responsibility of protecting fellow soldiers. However, as his reputation grows, the emotional and psychological toll of war begins affecting his personal life and relationships back home. Struggling to balance his military duties with his responsibilities as a husband and father, Kyle discovers that returning home can be just as challenging as surviving combat. Combining gripping action, emotional storytelling, and powerful performances, the film explores sacrifice, loyalty, trauma, family, and the lasting consequences of war.

🎭 Genre: Biography • War • Drama • Action

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 13m • R

🎥 Director: Clint Eastwood

🏆 Awards: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Sound Editing and nominated for six Oscars, including Best Picture and Best Actor for Bradley Cooper.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: American Sniper is a 2014 American biographical film directed and co-produced by Clint Eastwood and written and executive-produced by Jason Hall, based on the memoir of the same name by Chris Kyle with Scott McEwen and Jim DeFelice. The film follows the life of Kyle, who became the deadliest marksman in U.S. military history with 255 kills from four tours in the Iraq War, 160 of which were officially confirmed by the Department of Defense. While Kyle was celebrated for his military successes, his tours of duty took a heavy toll on his personal and family life. It stars Bradley Cooper as Kyle and Sienna Miller as his wife Taya, with Luke Grimes, Jake McDorman, Cory Hardrict, Kevin Lacz, Navid
